title: Aspherical $PD_3$-pairs
summary: We extend two results known for aspherical 3-manifolds to $PD_3$-pairs $(P,\partial{P})$ with aspherical ambient space $P$. Every such $PD_3$-pair may be assembled by attaching 1-handles to $PD_3$-pairs with aspherical; ambient space and $π_1$-injective boundary. (Thus the study of such pairs reduces to the study of $PD_3$-pairs of groups.) If $π$ is a group of type $FP$ whose indecomposable factors $G$ each have $χ(G_i)=0$ then there are only finitely many such $PD_3$-pairs with $π_1(P)\congπ$.
